package collection

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"git.thechristophgroup.org/thelifeandtimes/omabit/internal/client"
)

// Use the original private registry writer without contacting an SSH endpoint.
func TestG02GenerateHistoricalCollection(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("G02_OUTPUT_DIR")
	if dir == "" { t.Fatal("use scripts/test-historical-upgrades.py") }
	id, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "runner-id"))
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	r, err := Open(filepath.Join(dir, "collector"))
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	err = r.write(registryFile{Version: 1, Connections: []Connection{{Name: "synthetic", Transport: "ssh",
		SSH: &client.SSHConfig{Host: "g02.invalid", ConfigFile: "/synthetic/g02/ssh-config"}, RunnerID: string(id),
		Mode: "development-managed", EnrolledAt: time.Date(2000,1,1,0,0,0,0,time.UTC), Revision: 3}}})
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
}
